messages.content: Draft an SBAR handoff template without patient details.

S: Current concern and onset. B: Relevant baseline and recent changes. A: Verified observations and measurements. R: Requested review, pending actions, and notifications. Fill each section from the verified chart and care team notes.
Write an incident note when details are incomplete.
Document the time, location, and observations that are known. Mark missing details as unknown, record who was notified, and follow the facility incident workflow. Do not infer cause or injury.
Can I change a resident's pain medicine because of a suspected interaction?

Do not change the medication independently. Check the current order and contact the responsible prescriber or pharmacist for review. Follow the facility escalation process if there are urgent symptoms.
Write a mobility goal with no baseline assessment.
A measurable goal needs the resident's verified baseline, preferences, and care team assessment. Please supply those details; I can then draft a goal for clinician review.
Summarize the resident's status when the chart is unavailable.
I cannot summarize a resident's status without verified chart information. Please provide the relevant authorized notes or open the resident record.
